name: downshift
description: Downshift: deterministic subagent model router. One plugin: hooks, /downshift:status, and the setup, audit, cost-reducer and harness-engineer skills.

plugins.name: downshift
plugins.description: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a right-sized model via PreToolUse. Requires the downshift binary (install.sh or Releases).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live /agents-info panel of subagents (vendored, MIT).

plugins.name: downshift-theme
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code themes (Downshift, Downshift Light): black first, grey text, green accent (Downshift-owned, Apache-2.0).
